correctness.rationale: The second-order Schur/Jury conditions give the stated sink region. Applying them to reciprocal roots gives the source region \(|D|>1\) and \(|T|<|D+1|\); the remaining hyperbolic region is the saddle region \(|T|>|D+1|\), with the displayed unit-circle boundary. For the proposed positive parameter point, independent exact arithmetic reproduces \(H^*=1\), \(P^*=79/10\), the Jacobian \(\begin{pmatrix}-5&-1/2\79/5&1\end{pmatrix}\), \(T=-4\), \(D=29/10\), and roots \(-2\pm\sqrt{11/10}\). The source coexistence inequalities all hold. Thus one multiplier is inside and one outside the unit circle while both printed source and saddle predicates hold.
residual_risks: The finding corrects only the local fixed-point classification, not later bifurcation coefficients or numerical diagrams.
